description: Land Acquisition - Penideniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Angunawala, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired, including their locations, extents, and boundaries. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando) issuing the order, the core content is about land acquisition procedures and property details, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
